verdict.line: You lose if you Bladesurge in blind and eat his Q stun into a double W; you win if you farm from range, bank 4 Ionian Fervor stacks, and only commit once his cooldowns are down.

brief.thesis: Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) is a 5-second-cooldown poke-and-heal that lets him win extended trades without ever using his stun, so Irelia can't fight on his terms early — she has to bait his cooldowns and only engage once she's fully stacked. The measured 49% win rate over 1718 games and the defensive lane shape both reflect that Volibear dictates when the trade starts, not Irelia.

theirWindow.when: His Q (Thundering Smash) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He gains speed toward you and stuns the first champion he attacks at 300 range, then can chain into Frenzied Maul twice for damage plus a heal. Don't walk into auto range to trade while this is up — back off and farm with spells only.

yourWindow.when: You're at 4 Ionian Fervor stacks and his W/Q are down
yourWindow.what: Hit him with E (Flawless Duet) to stun and Mark him, then Bladesurge in — the dash refreshes instantly off the Mark so you can chain another Q before he can answer, and the max-stack bonus damage on-hit swings the trade your way.

start.why: The 86.9%-pick, 48.9%-win-rate start — the extra sustain and damage matter most here since you're trading into a champion whose W heals him back every exchange.

boots.why: The 53.6%-pick option and the better answer to Thundering Smash's stun and the magic damage his passive eventually adds to his autos.

core.why: The highest-pickrate first core item (22.9% of games) — percent-health damage and the on-hit slow help you actually catch him once you commit to a trade.
Pairs with BORK in the most-played build order and gives you the raw stats to keep trading as he itemizes for tankiness.
Closes out the 55.2%-win-rate core path — magic resist and attack speed scale your passive stacking against his mixed damage.

situational.when: if his Frenzied Maul recast healing is winning him extended trades
if you need to survive his level 6+ all-ins and keep fighting through his burst
if he's stacking health and you need more raw dueling damage instead of sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: The sustained damage and healing from stacking Conqueror is what lets you actually out-trade a champion whose own kit heals him in every exchange.

summoners.why: The most-played and best-performing pair here (49.1% win rate, 87.3% pick) — Ignite punishes his all-in windows and directly cuts into the W recast healing that's propping up his sustain.

playing.title: Farm from max range
playing.detail: Both his Q (300 range) and W (325 range) require him to close distance first, so stay at the edge of your own auto range and only step in to last-hit.

playing.title: Never Bladesurge in blind
playing.detail: A raw Q dash puts you right inside his Q stun zone with no answer; only commit it onto a target you've already Marked with E so it refreshes off the kill-mark instead of a cold engage.

playing.title: Hold W for his engage
playing.detail: Defiant Dance reduces physical damage taken while it charges — pop it the moment he dashes in with Q so his stun-into-double-W combo does less.

playing.title: Respect Sky Splitter poke
playing.detail: His E has 1200 range, slows, and shields him if he's caught in the blast; wait for it to go down (16s cooldown) before you commit your Q dash into a trade.

playing.title: Bank 4 stacks before trading
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor caps out and adds bonus on-hit damage at max stacks — poke with autos or E on minions so you walk into every real fight already empowered.

playing.title: Buy into his sustain
playing.detail: His W-into-W recast heals him in nearly every exchange; Executioner's Calling directly answers that if the trades keep slipping away.

playing.title: Play around his level 6 dive
playing.detail: Stormbringer grants him bonus health and disables your tower on landing — don't sit near turret once he hits 6, even if your own Vanguard's Edge is up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Volibear’s (E). Purchase Executioner’s Calling, and engage whenever Irelia has 4 stacks [P] ready to gain control over lane.
